newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products firm, gas oil leads.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firm, gas oil leads.

text.p: NWE oil products all jumped with crude on Monday, but gas oil led the way, trader said.
Gasoline was firmer as Eurograde barges gained $2 to trade at $215 a tonne fob ARA, but the U.S. arb was no longer viable.
Naphtha was talked $4/$5 a tonne higher with support from strong crude futures and the closure of the Skikda oil port.
Gas oil firmed considerably and traders expected more gains after two big refineries in the Amsterdam-Rotterdam area ran into difficulties.
Fuel oil was a touch stronger taking support from crude and tight supplies. High sulphur barges reached $120 fob ARA, up $1.
